name: f2-red-01-new-tests-committed-bytes
purpose: U040 fix 2 RED, archived BEFORE the fix (addendum 2): the new suites u040-flood, u040-budget and u040-expect against the COMMITTED server.cjs (sha256 db597b1c..., U040 fix 1). Finding F1 of the independent review: the F24 flood probe (3 sockets x 50 blocks of 64 KB behind a real transcript read, a refused read, or a held transcript, in a child with --max-old-space-size=48) kills the server child with exit 134 (Reached heap limit), because the requests that fix 1 drops are never answered and never stop the socket. The budget rows fail because the server never announces DROPPED_REQUEST_BACKLOG and never destroys the connection; the m1 rows fail because a read with Expect: 100-continue followed by a valid upgrade creates a hub session after an answer that says Connection: close. Controls that pass: [G][R] plus 16 dropped reads, an upgrade behind a marked connection, HTTP/1.1 pipelines without Expect, the documented limits m2 and m3.
